question: Which problems exceed the total number of times they appear in the solution table when counting all occurrences, across steps 1, 2, and 3, where any non-"Stack" model's maximum test score is lower than the "Stack" model's test score for the same step and version?
sql:
-- Just return the problem names
WITH conditions AS (
    SELECT ms.name, ms.version, ms.step,
           stack_score.test_score as stack_test_score,
           MAX(CASE WHEN ms.model != 'Stack' THEN ms.test_score END) as max_nonstack_test_score
    FROM model_score ms
    JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT name, version, step, test_score FROM model_score WHERE model = 'Stack') stack_score
      ON ms.name = stack_score.name AND ms.version = stack_score.version AND ms.step = stack_score.step
    WHERE ms.step IN (1, 2, 3)
    GROUP BY ms.name, ms.version, ms.step, stack_score.test_score
    HAVING MAX(CASE WHEN ms.model != 'Stack' THEN ms.test_score END) < stack_score.test_score
),
cond_counts AS (
    SELECT name, COUNT(*) as condition_count
    FROM conditions
    GROUP BY name
),
sol_counts AS (
    SELECT name, COUNT(*) as solution_count
    FROM solution
    GROUP BY name
)
SELECT sc.name
FROM sol_counts sc
JOIN cond_counts cc ON sc.name = cc.name
WHERE cc.condition_count > sc.solution_count
ORDER BY sc.name
